scientific_integrity: Analytical proof supported by an independently formulated exact-rational phase-partition diagnostic; no claim of empirical or external validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem for noiseless, instantaneous event centers, consecutive daily windows, narrow widths and near-one-day orbital periods; not a realistic transit-detection probability; historical priority not fully independently established.
title: A sharp two-sided daily-alias lobe law for sparse transit-center surveys
